summary: Fix SDK generation so a vendor OpenAPI description or operation summary cannot produce a module that fails to import.

evidence: Independent model review (gpt-6.1-sol) ran three read-only rounds against base 7be95b942c055a0ba0e52981a845435598a9cdec and approved the artifact at hashes e18a87b2/c8bb38cf/442af4d8. Round 1 rejected the first approach because quote-swapping does not escape trailing quotes, backslashes or escape sequences, and because operation summaries reach a second docstring sink. Round 2 found that the model-docstring branch was not covered by the tests. Both were fixed and re-reviewed.
The change is internal to SDK generation: existing integrations produce the same public surface, and no customer action, configuration change or upgrade step is required.
Published by the PR author on 2026-11-17 under the user's authorization; this disposition records that review, not a maintainer approval.
